BiblicalUsage: Gaddi son of Susi is one of the twelve spies, named in Numbers 13:11 as the spy of the tribe of Manasseh. He searched the land with the others and stood in the company that brought back the evil report. His name is kept in the list of the twelve.
TheologicalSignificance: Ten men came back with fear and two with faith, and Gaddi's name is on the fearful side. I hold that the report we believe shapes the future we get, and the majority is not always right.
